meta.name: deck-ljg-present
meta.description: 把 outline 1:1 铸成色块大字宣言 deck, 原文不动只做美化。三档主题 black / red / yellow

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把大纲一键转成大字宣言风格幻灯片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速把文字大纲变成视觉冲击力强的演示文稿。
copy.tagline_en: Turn outlines into bold statement decks with one click
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly turn text outlines into visually impactful presentations.

howto.what: 把你的 outline 或 Markdown 原样转成单文件 HTML 演示：只做分页和黑/红/黄三选一主题配色，不抽提、不重写、不重排、不插图。标题、段落、列表按规则拆成封面页、内容页、休止页，呈现为色块大字。
howto.when: 当你给出一份 outline 或 Markdown，并说要把它做成宣言式 deck、演讲幻灯片时触发；它会按分页规则把全文转成 HTML 翻页页。

say.text: 把这份 outline 做成宣言式 deck，用 red 主题。
say.note: 原文不改，按大纲拆页生成 HTML。

say.text: 这段内容做成 black 宣言页，标题和列表保持原样。
say.note: 黑色主题、左对齐大字，强调词会高亮。

howto.what_en: Turns the user's outline or Markdown into a single-file HTML slideshow exactly as written: only pagination and one of three themes (black/red/yellow), no rewriting, no images, no icons. Headings, paragraphs, and lists become full-page color-block slides with ultra-bold type.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you provide an outline or Markdown and ask for a manifesto-style deck or presentation slides. It maps the whole document into HTML pages following the split rules.

say_en.text: Turn this outline into a manifesto deck with the red theme.
say_en.note: Keeps the original text and paginates from the outline.

say_en.text: Use deck-ljg-present to turn my Markdown talk outline into a 16:9 slide page.
Make this content a black manifesto page, keeping headings and the list as-is.
say_en.note: Black theme, left-aligned type, highlights are kept.
